##### Project general facts

Nad Al Sheba Gardens Phase 7 is a prestigious residential development offering 3-bedroom townhouses in two- and three-level configurations, alongside a selection of spacious 4-, 5-, 6-, and 7-bedroom villas. The residences feature sophisticated contemporary architecture with clean lines, expansive glass windows, bronze accents, and carefully planned layouts that combine comfort, privacy, and functionality. Surrounded by lush greenery and landscaped pathways, the gated community creates an elegant and peaceful setting for modern family living.

The community offers an extensive range of world-class amenities designed to support an active and social lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a wave pool, lagoon, yoga lawn, running tracks, sports facilities, and a state-of-the-art gymnasium. Dedicated children’s play areas and a dog park cater to residents of all ages, while the events lawn and amphitheatre provide vibrant spaces for cultural gatherings, live performances, and community celebrations.

The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials and distinctive architectural details. The townhouses are characterised by sleek exteriors, articulated masses, bronze aluminium screens, wide glass windows, and expansive double-height interiors that create bright and inviting living spaces. The villas combine contemporary forms with stone and aluminium screens, adding a refined and sophisticated character to the homes. The kitchens are equipped, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Nad Al Sheba is located south of Dubai Creek, near the part of the city where indigenous people traditionally settle. Nad Al Sheba is close to Al Quoz, Silicon Dubai Oasis, Ras Al Khor industrial area and Al Markada. Properties here include villas, apartments and serviced apartments. A rich legacy awaits in a setting that resonates with all those who know the area.

The serene greenery of Nad Al Sheba is one of the city’s most covetable locations. A mere ten minutes from Downtown Dubai, this luxurious community has easy access to the Meydan Racetrack and many other premium leisure and lifestyle experiences. The Dubai International Airport and all major highways also lie within arm’s reach of Nad Al Sheba’s enviable location.

Nad Al Sheba Gardens is strategically located to give you the utmost in a privacy-focused lifestyle while connecting you to the best of Dubai’s city life. It’s a space built around carefully curated amenities. All this and more makes Nad Al Sheba Gardens a community tailored to truly nurture your inner and outer growth for today and future generations to come.
